## Personality

Milty Gammon harbors a deep dread of visiting his Uncle Simon's house. This overwhelming fear has continuously afflicted him since a specific past incident.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_

## History

Milty Gammon attended his cousin [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) Harriet's funeral alongside his mother and possessed a fine Indian headpiece made from white gobbler feathers given to him by his mother. Having already been a student for a year, he was considered rather a man of the world by his classmate [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md). He was later upset alongside other students when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigned from her teaching position, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) subsequently shared stories about him during a meal with his family.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), +5 more_
